justification: Although the case concerns peaceful assembly complaints under Article 11, the Article 11 merits are disposed of by a bare cross-reference to well-established case-law in a single omnibus paragraph without a standalone reasoned analysis, and the operative holding does not identify a specific Article 11 violation but instead bundles it with other complaints under a generic 'well-established case-law' finding, failing to constitute a genuine standalone Article 11 merits adjudication.
